title: Space Year
about: My first year in State Arts-In, arriving unsure and finding a place through the tech crew.
description: This track tells the story of stepping into State Arts-In at fifteen and being dropped into a loud, unfamiliar world of fairgrounds, stage lights, tools, radios, hidden spaces, and nonstop work. I arrived quiet and unsure, expecting to help build a spaceship-themed production. Instead, I found a crew, friendships, responsibility, and a place where I belonged. It captures how one intense week of building, learning, and working beside strangers became the beginning of something much bigger in my life.
